info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Checkout Retrieval API provides businesses with the capability to access and list all the checkouts currently present in the ecommerce cart. This operation is essential for retrieving detailed information about customer checkout sessions, including transaction statuses and associated cart items. Typical consumers of this API include ecommerce managers and analytics platforms that need to monitor checkout activities for improving sales strategies and customer experiences. By leveraging this API, users can effectively track and analyze checkout processes to enhance overall operational efficiency.

get.summary: Initiate the checkout process for the shopping cart.
get.description: This API endpoint starts the checkout procedure for the current user's shopping cart. It calculates the total amount, applies any discounts or promotions, and prepares the order for payment processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the checkout process for items in the cart. It contains the necessary information required for processing the checkout, including user details and payment preferences.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the checkout information.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the checkout endpoint for the shopping cart. It contains a placeholder string value.

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the checkout response.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the checkout operation.

state.description: Current state of the checkout operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the checkout operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the checkout operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the checkout operation.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Response schema for successful checkout operations.
